newsitem.title: USA: Pepsi Puerto Rico says settles lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Pepsi Puerto Rico says settles lawsuit.

text.p: Pepsi-Cola Puerto Rico Bottling Co said Thursday that it and other defendants reached settlement with plaintiffs in the class action lawsuits against the company.

The company said the settlement, which must be approved by a judge, would result in payment of $2.5 million and 2.5 million issued and outstanding Class B shares to the plaintiffs and their attorneys.

The company also said it is commencing litigation in the courts of the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico against its liability insurance carriers to force the carriers to indemnify the company for the costs of settlement and other expenses.
